correctness.rationale: The standard polar/Gale two-factor reduction fixes the domain. Joining product faces is union in each factor. Cardinality bounds force exact complementary partitions and hence the binomial convolution. An explicit polynomial balancing identity has strictly positive coefficients at every rank, certified by exact binomial monotonicity. The explicit face enumerator passed all tests up through dimension seven, and all general claims have analytical proofs.

value.rationale: The minimal possible deviation from a simplex in facet number is quantified by complete rank-indexed witness counts. A strict simultaneous monotonicity theorem, valid at every dimension and each admissible complementary rank, orders the full family of simple d+2-facet polytopes and gives rigid sharp extremal classes. The exact finite incidence profile naturally benchmarks face-lattice rigidity without assuming any volume stability inequality.
